work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act confirms and renews the indulgences granted by Pius IV to the former public chapel of St Mary and St Michael outside Verona, now a rectorial church. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF6128; own dating clause LF6178–6181 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo. Piscatoris die vigesima nona iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF6255 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
